about: EDS's messages in Rune's words, shared by Rune (messages.ts) and Tolk (eds-cli, internal/messages). EDS says Circle and Data Object, Rune says room and file. 'pattern' is a regular expression that both JavaScript and Go understand; 'text' is the English text, a key of the catalogs in i18n/; 'values' fills its {name} from a group of the pattern, formatted as a size where it says so. Messages without an entry stay in English, with 'words' replaced.

messages.pattern: ^The current Account is not allowed to perform the given action\.?$
messages.text: You don't have permission to do that in this room.

messages.pattern: ^The requesting Account is not permitted to Process Data\.?$
messages.text: You can only read in this room.

messages.pattern: ^The requesting Account is not permitted to Process a Trustee\.?$
messages.text: Only administrators of this room can change who has which access.

messages.pattern: ^The Member is already a trustee of the requested Circle\.?$
messages.text: This user is already in the room.

messages.pattern: ^Only its author may edit a message\.?$
messages.text: Only the author can edit a message.

messages.pattern: ^Only its author may delete a message\.?$
messages.text: Only the author can delete a message.

messages.pattern: ^Join the Circle before sending to it\.?$
messages.text: You have to be in the room to send messages to it.

messages.pattern: ^The access to the Circle has ended\.?$
messages.text: You are no longer in this room.

messages.pattern: ^The shared Data Object '.*' is not part of the Circle\.?$
messages.text: The shared file isn't in this room.

messages.pattern: ^A chat message can't share the chat\.?$
messages.text: Messages can't be shared as files.

messages.pattern: ^Another record with the same name already exists\.?$
messages.text: A file or folder with this name already exists here.

messages.pattern: ^The Data Object could not be found\.?$
messages.text: The file could not be found; it may have been deleted.

messages.pattern: ^The content cannot be stored, the storage limit of EDS is reached\.?$
messages.text: The stone is out of storage space, so the file wasn't stored.

messages.pattern: ^The content is larger than the allowed (\d+) bytes\.?$
messages.text: The file is larger than the stone allows ({size}).

messages.pattern: ^The Credential is too weak\. (.*)$
messages.text: The passphrase is too weak. {detail}

messages.pattern: ^The Folder cannot be removed as it is not empty\.?$
messages.text: Only empty folders can be deleted. Delete or move its files first.

messages.pattern: ^The name '.*' provided is already being used in the given folder\.?$
messages.text: A file or folder with this name already exists there.

messages.pattern: ^It is not permitted to move Folders\.?$
messages.text: Folders can't be moved, only files.

messages.pattern: ^Folders have no content\.?$
messages.text: Folders can't be opened as files.

messages.pattern: The (new )?name of (the new )?(the )?Data Object is invalid
messages.text: The name is empty or too long (at most 75 characters).
